title: The Fork Trick
setup: You gave up a knight on e4 a move ago, and White now has a knight and a bishop on the same rank.
hint: Which single pawn move attacks the knight and the bishop at the same time?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{d5}} hits the knight on e4 and the bishop on c4 together, and it frees your own bishop on c8 at the same time. This is the fork trick: hand over a knight for a pawn, then win the piece straight back with a pawn.
